levels.name: Street
levels.note: Local street level. The ground is not perfectly flat, so depths are good to about a metre.

levels.name: Upper mezzanine
levels.note: 27.6 ft below street level. The 34 St and 35 St halls are at the same depth but do not connect. Hall perimeter, opening sizes and guard positions are scenario reconstructions; shaft landing coordinates are source-rebuilt, not surveyed.

levels.name: Lower mezzanine
levels.note: 109 ft below street level. Both entrances lead to it.

levels.name: Platform
levels.note: 125 ft below street level. One island platform, two tracks.

zones.name: Upper mezzanine, 34 St hall
zones.note: OSM entrance centre line with assumed 14 m width. Joins the unified curved landing hall; former mitred side arms removed.

zones.name: Upper mezzanine, round hall
zones.note: Reconstructed curved hall joined to the existing shaft landing line (l=-74.7 m); no independent surveyed plan. The 15 m curve radius, 0.7–1.45 m side margins and resulting perimeter are scenario dimensions, not confirmed wall positions. Machine endpoints retain their published-section / OSM reconstruction.

zones.name: Passage to the street elevator
zones.note: Nothing public shows this link. It joins the elevator to the hall by the shortest way.

zones.name: Upper mezzanine, 35 St hall
zones.note: OSM centre line and existing source-rebuilt escalator endpoints retained. Rounded bend and tapered approach end perpendicular to the long escalators. 14 m hall width and 8.6 m terminal width are scenario dimensions, not a measured wall plan.

zones.name: Lower mezzanine
zones.note: Runs the full length of the platform, above it, under one vault. Measured on Dattner's scaled section: 18.4 m wide inside the walls and 7.7 m to the crown, with 5 m wide decks either side of the openings over the platform.

zones.name: Landing, north shaft
zones.note: A 21.6 m passage from the hall to the foot of the long escalators, 4.4 m high (Dattner's section).

zones.name: Landing, south shaft
zones.note: Joins the bottom of the escalator and inclined elevators to the hall, as in Dattner's axonometric.

zones.name: Landing, 35 St escalators
zones.note: Joins the bottom of the escalators to the hall, as in Dattner's axonometric.

zones.name: Island platform
zones.note: 585 ft by 35 ft (178 by 10.7 m) from a secondary source; Dattner's scaled section also measures 35 ft wide. Its axis is the OSM track centre line. It is centred on the official stop position.

zones.name: Track
zones.note: OSM places the tracks 13.6 m apart, which fits a 10.7 m platform between them.

fare_lines.name: Fare control, north bank

The array is offset along its line by one illustrative lane pitch, keeping the existing route through an open lane and all cabinets clear of the shaft mouth.

section.comment: Across the platform, measured on Dattner's section (0.0778 m per pixel of the 2000 px picture; its scale bar). x = metres from the platform centre, east is negative l. y = metres above the lower mezzanine floor.

known_issues.text: The inventory gives 30 ft (9.1 m) for the street escalators, while the MTA gives the upper mezzanine as 27.6 ft (8.4 m). The model uses the MTA's level depths.
Listed with a 12 ft rise and 55 steps, unlike the other three at its entrance (30 ft, about 110 steps). Not explained in the data, so it is drawn like the others.

ES633, ES634 and ES635 are listed with 28 ft and 24 ft rises, but they are described as reaching the lower mezzanine, about 81 ft down. Only ES636 fits: its 83.3 has no unit, and 288 steps confirm feet.

Many machines share one position, and some are far from where they must be: EL600 (platform elevator) sits at the 35 St end, and ES627 to ES629 sit about 50 m east of their entrance, outside the official outline. Positions here come from entrances and OSM instead.
The outline's rounded corners suggest it is drawn with a margin. It marks the area that holds the station, not its walls.
Only public circulation is modelled. Staff rooms, plant rooms, emergency exits and other non-public spaces are left out on purpose.

known_issues.topic: Upper hall boundary and opening details
known_issues.text: Scenario: unified curved hall perimeter, guard geometry, 0.65 m equipment end plates and 2.5 m opening headroom. Existing source-rebuilt machine endpoints are retained; neither the perimeter nor exact equipment landing coordinates are survey-confirmed.
